title.narrative: Analysis of taxonomies and definition of common investment framework for a credit program with NADB

description.narrative: Analyse AFD taxonomies and assess their compatibility with NADB's sustainable bond framework and green loan program to identify potential projects that could be funded by EUR 100 million by AFD. This credit line will include a EUR 2 million technical assistance component that could be implemented by GGGI. As a result, this consultation could pave the way for an earmarked project in 2025.

The project’s objective is to align AFD’s taxonomies with NADB’s sustainable bond framework and green loan program, creating a common investment framework for climate projects. Key components include:AFD-NADB Common Framework: Development of a unified investment framework that aligns NADB’s green loan program with AFD’s sustainable financing criteria.Technical Assistance Program: Structuring concessional support for project development, potentially managed by GGGI.Identification of Eligible Projects: Evaluating projects that align with AFD’s credit line criteria to support Mexico’s climate action goals.Program Design: Designing a structured credit line that combines financing and technical assistance, laying the groundwork for continued collaboration in 2025.

participating-org.narrative: Agence Fraçaise de Développement / French Development Agency (AFD)
